description: External alterations to include: Repair and redecoration of windows and doors, vegetation removal, re-lamp & cleaning to roof lanterns, minor works to external seating, planters, and paving; associated external alterations.
subdivision_of_building: Lower Ground Floor, Ground Floor & Roof Plan
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

- 157-D-01
- 157-EV02
- 157-LBC-01 
- 157-R02
- 157-V02
- Agent Email dated 19.08.2026
- ESP Range Datasheet
- Internal Photographs 
- Kitchen Extract UV-0 Range Datasheet 
- Multi Filtration Unit Range Datasheet
- Plant Noise Assessment Report (Ref. EEC/EC21779-2, dated May 2026) prepared by Environmental Equipment Corporation Ltd. 

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - Prior to commencement of the relevant external works, details (including photographs of physical samples) of the materials to be used shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details. 

To preserve the significance of the Listed Building, in accordance with Policies HE4 � HE6 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - All existing historic features including, but not limited to, chimney pieces, plasterwork, architraves, panelling, doors, staircase balustrading shall remain undisturbed in their existing position and shall be fully protected during the course of works on site, unless specifically authorised otherwise on the drawings hereby approved. The development and works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

To preserve the significance of the Listed Building, in accordance with Policies HE4 � HE6 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - All disturbed surfaces shall be made good using materials to match the existing materials, composition, form, finish and colour of the existing building. 

To preserve the significance of the Listed Building, in accordance with Policies HE4 � HE6 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - The external sound level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the lowest existing background sound level by at least 10dBA in order to prevent any adverse impact. The assessment shall be made in accordance with BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from plant/mechanical installations/ equipment, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 7 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment, extract/ ventilation system and ducting at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 8 - The odour abatement equipment shall be installed and maintained, for the lifetime of the development, in accordance with the approved drawing no. 157-V02, MFU Range Datasheet, ESP Range Datasheet and UV-O Range Datasheet and the agent email dated 19.08.2026. 

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by odour, in accordance with Policy CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 9 - The use of the premise shall only be open to customers between the hours of:

Monday � Thursday (10:00am � 12:30am)
Friday � Saturday (10:00am � 01:00am)
Sunday (10:00am � 11:30pm) 

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 10 - At the subject premises, no deliveries nor collections/ loading nor unloading shall occur other than between the hours of 10:00 to 16:00 and 19:00-22:00 on Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 18:00 on Saturdays and at no time on Sundays and Public/Bank Holidays.

To ensure an acceptable impact on highways and neighbouring amenity, in accordance with Policies HO11 and T1 of the Local Plan (2018).
